zh: 在还没有赢家时，新出现的三连一定包含刚落下的这颗子，所以每步只需要检查经过新落子的直线。
经过新落子有四个方向（横、竖、两条斜线）。连胜长度固定为 3，每个方向往两侧各看最多 2 格、统计同一玩家的连续棋子即可。
用一维数组存棋盘。每次操作依次判断：已有赢家输出 Game Over；格子已占用输出 Invalid Move；否则落子、计数加一，检查四个方向是否有一侧加另一侧再加自身 ≥3，是则 Player x won，否则棋盘满了输出 Draw，不然输出 In Progress。
en: While there is no winner yet, any new line of three must contain the stone just placed, so each move only needs to check the lines through that cell.

There are four directions through the new stone (horizontal, vertical and two diagonals). The winning length is always 3, so in each direction look at most 2 cells to each side and count the same player's consecutive stones.

Store the board in a flat array. For each move check in order: if a winner exists print Game Over; if the cell is taken print Invalid Move; otherwise place the stone, increase the occupied count, and if some direction has at least 3 in a row (both sides plus the stone) print Player x won, else Draw when the board is full, else In Progress.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Store the board in an array. After a stone is placed, check only the four directions through it, looking at most 2 cells to each side. Check for an existing winner and for an occupied cell first.

## Correctness

Since there was no winner before, any new line of three must include the newly placed cell. The four directions enumerate every line, and at most 2 cells on each side are enough to decide whether a line of length 3 is formed. The order of the status checks matches the rules.

## Complexity

O(n²+m) time and O(n²) space; each win check is O(1).
